g.text: Every registered nomination paper follows the same admission gates

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536675

g.text: Counts are cumulative. Color shows the fraction of each row's input remaining.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536675

g.text: Paper rows overlap and must not be added. The union and unannotated rows partition the full inventory.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536675

g.text: Nomination scopes include CTA, germ-cell, placental and vascular lists. Membership records provenance; measured evidence determines admission.
